bk_refuse_success: Appointment refused. The client has been notified.
bk_cancel_success: Appointment cancelled. The client has been notified.
bk_delete_confirm: Permanently delete this appointment? This cannot be undone.
bk_availability_lunch_break_help: When enabled, no appointment can be booked during this window, even if it only partially overlaps.
bk_availability_exceptions_help: Override the weekly hours for one or more consecutive dates — holidays, for example. Check 'Closed all day' to close entirely, or set custom hours that replace the normal schedule for those dates.
bk_availability_exception_hours_help: These hours replace the day's normal schedule entirely — they are not a closure window within it.
bk_availability_conflict_title: Availability not saved — existing appointments conflict
bk_availability_conflict_intro: The hours you tried to save would leave the following appointment(s) outside your availability. Refuse or cancel them from the Requests tab, then save availability again — nothing has been changed yet.
bk_availability_conflict_closed: Falls on a day now marked closed
bk_settings_from_email_help: Leave empty to use noreply@ followed by your domain name.
bk_settings_send_pending_email: Send a receipt email to the client on submission
bk_settings_send_pending_email_help: When enabled, the client receives an acknowledgement email as soon as they submit their request. Disable it if you confirm appointments immediately and prefer to send only the confirmation email.
bk_settings_show_dashboard_widget: Show appointments widget on the admin dashboard
bk_settings_show_cancel_link_in_email: Include a cancellation link in the client's emails
bk_settings_show_cancel_link_in_email_he: When enabled, the pending and confirmation emails end with a small link letting the client cancel their own appointment. Disable it if cancellations must always go through you.
bk_settings_restrict_callback: Restrict requested callback times to configured availability hours
bk_settings_enable_callback: Enable callback request option on the booking form
bk_settings_enable_callback_help: When disabled, the callback checkbox and date/time fields are hidden from the public form. Existing bookings with a callback request are unaffected.
bk_settings_restrict_callback_help: When enabled, visitors can only request a callback within the hours set in the Availability tab. When disabled, any time of day can be requested.
bk_settings_slot_display_hide: Hide them — only bookable times are shown
bk_settings_slot_display_show: Show them greyed out — visitors see the full schedule
bk_settings_cancel_notice_help: The one-click cancellation link in confirmation emails stops working this many hours before the appointment. Past this point, clients see a polite message asking them to contact you directly. Set to 0 to allow cancellation right up until the appointment starts.
bk_settings_ics_intro: Controls the calendar event attached to the client's confirmation emails. Leave a field empty to use the default. Click a placeholder to insert it into the focused field.
bk_settings_types_help: The internal key identifies the type in the system and is never shown to visitors — use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only. Changing it later will not update appointments already booked under the old key.
bk_ff_help: Choose which client fields appear on the form, which ones are required, and customise their label and placeholder. Leave a label or placeholder empty to use the default text. At least one of email and phone always stays enabled, and without an email address the client receives no confirmation emails.
bk_smtp_test_failed: The test email could not be sent.
bk_smtp_brevo_hint: Fills in the Brevo server (smtp-relay.brevo.com, port 587, STARTTLS) and turns SMTP on. Then enter the SMTP login and SMTP key found in Brevo under SMTP & API (not your account e-mail and password), and use a sender address validated in Brevo, otherwise Brevo rejects the message.
bk_smtp_brevo_applied: Brevo server settings applied. Enter your SMTP login and key, then save.
bk_smtp_intro: By default, this plugin sends emails through your hosting provider's built-in mail server. That works, but delivery quality (spam placement, bounce visibility) varies a lot between hosts. Connecting a dedicated SMTP provider (Brevo, Mailjet, Amazon SES, or your email provider's own SMTP) generally improves this. Leave disabled if you're not sure — the plugin will keep working exactly as before.
bk_smtp_enabled: Send emails via SMTP instead of the server's default mail function
bk_smtp_auth: This server requires a username and password
bk_smtp_password_help: Leave empty when saving to keep the currently stored password unchanged. Type a new one to replace it.
bk_smtp_test_help: Sends a short test email using the settings currently saved above (save your changes first). Uses SMTP if enabled, otherwise the server's default mail function — useful to confirm either path is actually working.
bk_smtp_test_body: This is a test email from the Booking plugin’s SMTP settings. If you received this, your configuration is working.
bk_smtp_test_error_generic: Check whether your host's mail function is configured, or enable SMTP above.
bk_emails_intro: Write a custom email for each appointment status. Leave a template empty to use the default text instead. Available placeholders: {first_name}, {last_name}, {full_name}, {date}, {time}, {type}.
bk_login_required: Please log in to the CMS admin panel to access this page.
